test_info_empty: test the DataFrame.info() method on an empty DataFrame and verify the output format
test_info_memory_usage: test the DataFrame.info() method with memory_usage parameter to verify byte reporting accuracy
test_info_verbose_with_counts_spacing: test the DataFrame.info() verbose mode with show_counts for various column counts and spacing
